prompts.base: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production layered pixel-art office background. Edit the supplied 1536x1024 office image. Preserve exact canvas size, room perspective, walls, floor tile grid, window frames and mullions, bookshelves, cabinets, plants, tools, sofa, door, boxes, shadows, original raster pixel style and all their locations. Remove ONLY all eight freestanding computer desks with everything on those eight desks and their floor shadows; fill those regions with matching uninterrupted tiled floor. Remove the round wall clock and fill with matching wall texture. Remove daylight views inside both windows, leaving genuinely transparent alpha window openings, but KEEP all dark window frames and center mullions in their exact positions. No other changes, no robots, no labels. This is a reusable game background layer, not a redesigned room.
prompts.desk: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent production game sprite. Extract ONLY the second computer desk in the top row of the supplied office reference: tan wooden desk, black legs, centered monitor, muted green keyboard, left cup of pens and loose screwdrivers, right mouse and circular cable, right green angled desk lamp and small black/orange electronics unit. Preserve the exact pixel-art style, proportions, perspective, original arrangement. One desk only, centered fully visible with generous transparent padding on all sides, genuine alpha transparency (not checkerboard). Exclude ALL floor tiles, background, wall, other desks, robots, chair, text and logos. Monitor is sleeping: plain nearly black display, subtle reflection, no glowing content. All other desk items unchanged. Render this small sprite crisply, not as enlarged chunky pixel blocks.
prompts.day: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable pixel-art window scenery texture. Use the city visible through the supplied office windows as style reference only. Draw a single continuous wide daytime city vista, light blue sky, a few fluffy white pixel clouds, soft blue midrise buildings of different heights, small square pale windows, lush muted green tree canopy across the lower edge. Front-on viewpoint. Match the office's soft raster pixel shading, restrained saturation and pixel scale. 1536x768 landscape. Scene fills every edge, no window frames, no interior, no border, no text, no people. This will be cropped behind two window holes.
prompts.night: Use case: lighting-weather. Convert this exact daytime city vista to nighttime. Preserve exact image size, buildings, tree silhouettes, pixel grid and positions. Deep muted indigo sky, dark blue buildings, dark green trees, a scattering of small warm yellow lit windows, a small crescent moon in upper sky, a few subtle stars. No added buildings, no frames, no text. Scene fills all edges.
prompts.dawn: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: supplied daytime pixel-art city window texture. Produce a DAWN version of this exact scene, suitable for 05:00–08:00 local time. Pale peach and soft pink glow near horizon blending into light lavender-blue upper sky, warm pale clouds, cool slightly misty blue buildings, fresh muted green trees, a few remaining warm lit windows. Make it clearly distinct from bright blue midday and orange sunset while still bright enough to read. Preserve every building, cloud and tree silhouette, position, crop, pixel scale, soft raster pixel-art style and exact 1774x887 size. Change lighting/colors only. No text, frame, border, sun disc, new buildings or objects. Fill every edge.
prompts.dusk: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: supplied daytime pixel-art city window texture. Produce a DUSK version of this exact scene, suitable for 17:00–20:00 local time. Strong warm apricot-orange horizon blending into dusty rose and muted violet upper sky, peach-pink clouds, warm purple-blue buildings, deeper olive/teal trees, several small warm golden lit windows. Clearly distinguish it from pale dawn, bright blue midday, and dark indigo night. Preserve every building, cloud and tree silhouette, position, crop, pixel scale, soft raster pixel-art style and exact 1774x887 size. Change lighting/colors only. No text, frame, border, sun disc, new buildings or objects. Fill every edge.
prompts.screen_animation: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: four-frame computer screen animation sprite sheet for the attached pixel-art office desk. Draw ONLY four monitor DISPLAY INTERIORS, not monitor frames or desks. Arrange EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows in a regular edge-to-edge 2x2 grid, each cell has identical size and occupies its whole quarter of a 1536x1024 canvas. Every cell is a nearly black green flat display matching the attached desk's display. In each cell put tiny mint-green pixel horizontal code strokes only in the top quarter of that cell, starting around 5% from the left, with a small block cursor. Frame order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Frame 1: a short first line and cursor. Frame 2: first line lengthens and second short line starts. Frame 3: second line lengthens with cursor lit. Frame 4: same two lines with cursor off, slight new short code stroke. Restrained brightness, no glow, no gradients, no grid gutters, no borders, no labels, no text/numbers, no objects, no display hardware. Bottom 70% of each cell remains the identical solid dark green, leaving room for the app's overlaid role label. Keep code line positions, baseline, thickness and dark background consistent so these four cells will animate smoothly after slicing.

packaging: Registered window alpha; four generated display cells resized and copied into one unchanged sleeping desk master, then packed as a horizontal atlas. Clock face rasterized from native SVG.
